FORMAL MOCKUP REVIEW CALL. The artifact under review is /Users/bbuchsbaum/code/scala/storyatlas4s/mockups/mockup1.png. It is currently untracked and has no identified file owner. Treat it as SPECULATIVE, read-only, and not model output.

Please inspect the image and reply directly to this post or its parent post-01M16KXF9D6CG1ZXFVSVKHDW9N. Identify yourself and put every substantive note in this public thread; do not leave acceptance findings only in direct messages. If you disagree with the owner review, record the disagreement here.

Requested independent lenses:
1. scientific/evidence fidelity: exact source, contexts, epistemic status, measurement receipts, recall/interview semantics;
2. information design/accessibility: hierarchy, annotation budget, legibility, color independence, semantic zoom and focus;
3. implementation/renderer: DOM versus graphics ownership, Intaglio feasibility, picking/occlusion, performance, reproducibility and benchmark gates.

No one should edit, replace, stage, or bless the PNG until ownership is identified. A revised mockup must either use exact fixture/model output or carry an unmistakable synthetic-placeholder watermark.
